class_id: status regressed by a source despite the legal-transition rule
feature: ipos.status and ipos.listing_date for every IPO (MAINBOARD and SME, NSE/BSE), written by the scraper consolidation resolver, the web status updater and the consolidation-update write in data-persister.ts
symptom: a status field declared as a one-way ladder (UPCOMING->OPEN->CLOSED->LISTED) is resolved as an ordinary newest-wins field, so any newer source row, including the same exchange's own feed, moves it backwards; and a date that decides the status is blanked by a sanitizer that writes NULL for 'no usable value', so a derived-status job reads the absence as a value and demotes the row too. Wider shape: an ordering invariant enforced in the spec but not at the one resolver every write passes lets each writer undo the others' forward progress.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 -- IPODhan staging (supervisor, read-only): 4 IPOs with a listing_performance row and ipos.status <> LISTED or listing_date NULL; lumino-industries-ltd status provenance NSE -> NSE, previous_value LISTED, 2026-09-07 13:59 UTC; glass-wall-systems-india-ltd and lumino keep listingDate provenance while ipos.listing_date is NULL. F-178.
